# Configuration

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-config-docs.ts from src/lib/config/registry.ts — do not edit by hand. -->

Better Search Lab needs two environment variables to boot. Everything else is configured in the app under **Settings → Integrations**, and every one of those settings can also be supplied as an environment variable — when both are set, **the environment wins** and the field shows as read-only in the app.

## Bootstrap environment

| Variable | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` | yes | Postgres connection string (`postgres://…`). docker compose sets it for you. |
| `AUTH_SECRET` | yes | Session-signing secret, at least 32 characters (`openssl rand -base64 32`). Also derives the key that encrypts integration secrets at rest. |
| `APP_URL` | recommended | Public URL of this install. Used for the Google OAuth redirect, links in emails, and as the auth base URL. Also settable in Settings → Integrations → App. |
| `ENCRYPTION_KEY` | no | 32-byte base64 key for encrypting integration secrets, instead of the key derived from `AUTH_SECRET`. Set it before the first secret is saved, or re-enter secrets after rotating. |
| `DEMO_MODE` | no | `true` boots the read-only demo with two synthetic sites and refuses every write. |
| `TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS` | no | How many reverse proxies append to `X-Forwarded-For` (default 1). Used only to pick the client address for login rate limiting. |

## Integrations

Each table lists the in-app field, the environment variable that overrides it, and older variable names that are still honoured so an existing `.env` keeps working.

### App

How this install is reached from the outside.

| Setting | Environment variable | Legacy names | Secret | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| App URL | `APP_URL` | — | no | Public base URL of this install, e.g. https://seo.example.com. Used for the Google OAuth redirect and links in emails. |

### DataForSEO

The data backbone: rankings, keyword research, competitors, backlinks.

| Setting | Environment variable | Legacy names | Secret | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Login | `DATAFORSEO_LOGIN` | — | no | DataForSEO API login (usually your account email). |
| API password | `DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD` | — | yes | From app.dataforseo.com → API access. |

### AI assistant

Powers niche extraction during profiling, the advisor's action phrasing, and the Reddit judge and drafter.

| Setting | Environment variable | Legacy names | Secret | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Provider | `LLM_PROVIDER` | — | no | Which chat API to use. One of: `deepseek`, `openai`, `anthropic`, `openrouter`, `groq`, `together`, `gemini`, `ollama`, `custom`. |
| Base URL | `LLM_BASE_URL` | — | no | OpenAI-compatible endpoint root (filled by the preset; ignored for Anthropic). |
| API key | `LLM_API_KEY` | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | yes | May be empty for a local Ollama. |
| Model | `LLM_MODEL` | — | no | Model id; the preset suggests one, the dropdown lists what the provider reports. |
| Effort | `LLM_EFFORT` | — | no | Reasoning depth for Anthropic models only. One of: `low`, `medium`, `high`. |

### Google

Search Console and Analytics, via a service account or OAuth.

| Setting | Environment variable | Legacy names | Secret | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| OAuth client ID | `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` | — | no | From Google Cloud → APIs & Services → Credentials. |
| OAuth client secret | `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` | — | yes | Pairs with the client ID. |
| Service-account key (JSON) | `GOOGLE_SA_KEY` | — | yes | Raw or base64 JSON key. When set, syncs authenticate as the service account: no user, no reauth, nothing to expire. Grant it access to the GA4 property and the Search Console property. |
| OAuth redirect URI | `GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI` | — | no | Optional. Defaults to <App URL>/api/google/callback. Register the effective value in Google Cloud. |

### Eden AI

One key for the AI-visibility scan across Perplexity, ChatGPT and Gemini.

| Setting | Environment variable | Legacy names | Secret | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| API key | `EDENAI_API_KEY` | — | yes | From app.edenai.run. |
| Perplexity model | `EDEN_SONAR_MODEL` | — | no | Eden model id for the Perplexity engine. |
| ChatGPT model | `EDEN_CHATGPT_MODEL` | — | no | Eden model id for the ChatGPT engine. |
| Gemini model | `EDEN_GEMINI_MODEL` | — | no | Eden model id for the Gemini engine. |

### Email

Weekly AI-visibility report and the daily Reddit digest.

| Setting | Environment variable | Legacy names | Secret | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Provider | `EMAIL_PROVIDER` | — | no | How reports are sent. One of: `none`, `resend`, `smtp`. |
| Resend API key | `RESEND_API_KEY` | — | yes | For the Resend provider. |
| SMTP host | `SMTP_HOST` | — | no | For the SMTP provider. |
| SMTP port | `SMTP_PORT` | — | no | 465 for implicit TLS, 587 for STARTTLS. |
| SMTP user | `SMTP_USER` | — | no | Leave empty for an unauthenticated relay. |
| SMTP password | `SMTP_PASSWORD` | — | yes | Pairs with the SMTP user. |
| SMTP implicit TLS | `SMTP_SECURE` | — | no | true for port 465, false for STARTTLS on 587. One of: `true`, `false`. |
| From address | `EMAIL_FROM` | `REPORT_EMAIL_FROM` | no | e.g. Better Search Lab <reports@example.com>. |
| Report recipient | `REPORT_EMAIL_TO` | — | no | Where the weekly report and daily digest go. |

### Reddit API

Primary source for Conversations worth joining (free, application-only OAuth).

| Setting | Environment variable | Legacy names | Secret | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Client ID | `REDDIT_CLIENT_ID` | — | no | From reddit.com/prefs/apps (script or web app). |
| Client secret | `REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET` | — | yes | Pairs with the client ID. |
| User agent | `REDDIT_USER_AGENT` | — | no | Reddit asks for platform:app:version (by /u/yourname). |

### Apify

Fallback Reddit source when the official API is absent or fails.

| Setting | Environment variable | Legacy names | Secret | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| API token | `APIFY_API_KEY` | — | yes | From console.apify.com → Integrations. |
| Reddit actor | `APIFY_REDDIT_ACTOR` | — | no | Apify actor id used to scrape Reddit. |

## AI assistant presets

Choosing a provider fills the base URL and a default model; both stay editable.

| Provider | Base URL | Default model | Needs a key |
|---|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek (`deepseek`) | `https://api.deepseek.com` | `deepseek-flash` | yes |
| OpenAI (`openai`) | `https://api.openai.com/v1` | `gpt-5` | yes |
| Anthropic (`anthropic`) | — | `claude-opus-5` | yes |
| OpenRouter (`openrouter`) | `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` | `openai/gpt-5` | yes |
| Groq (`groq`) | `https://api.groq.com/openai/v1` | `llama-3.3-70b-versatile` | yes |
| Together (`together`) | `https://api.together.xyz/v1` | `meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo` | yes |
| Google Gemini (`gemini`) | `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai` | `gemini-2.5-flash` | yes |
| Ollama (local) (`ollama`) | `http://localhost:11434/v1` | `llama3.1` | no |
| Custom OpenAI-compatible (`custom`) | — | — | yes |
